method.primary: Known-nonempty GT-jitter slots0..7; patch means within case, then equal PROBE12 cases
method.fine: Sum fine_covered/sum fine_nodes within each case primary patches; then equal supported cases; patch means retained separately
method.counts: FP/FN/TP means per sampled primary patch then per case, not native volumes; overlapping predictions are not independent cases
method.utility: AR mean Dice strictly greater than BOTH C0/A_only; clDice/CLrecall/fine and own-worst2 nonworse
method.training: 2000 successful updates/arm; same seed/plan/initialization, common4226 projection parameters plus192 gates; original main Dice+BCE only; no attribute/DS/GDF loss
method.mechanism: OwnA unchanged; same patch A1 flattened R values half-ring roll floor(N/2); exact support and complete R multiset retained
method.mechanism_gate: Mean correct-minus-permuted Dice>=.1pp, at least8 strictly positive cases, all12 supported
method.mechanism_support: At least2 primary known-nonempty slots, positive supported log-radius variance, actual consumed FP32 zR changes, finite measurements
method.missing: Unsupported values remain null/inconclusive, never imputed0 or used as scientific negative evidence
method.oracle: GT sparse native-EDT proxy support/radius only; geometry unknowns consume neutral0 but are not negative radius labels
method.stability: Cross-case dispersion and tails only; not test-time variance or independent cohorts
method.seeds: Three fixed seeds reported separately; PRIMARY cannot be rescued; no best seed or pooling
method.scope: Oracle-conditioned TRAIN capability candidate, not CT deployment, not a mathematical upper bound, not native validation or GTA efficacy
method.cross_round: New radius definition plus co-adaptation; differences from old rounds cannot isolate either change

recipe.sampler: FIT24 case-uniform and original16-slot-uniform; same plan per seed across all arms

units.metric_fractions: Dice/clDice/recall stored0..1; displayed percentages are fraction×100
units.effects: Dice/recall differences are percentage points, not relative percent
units.FP_FN_TP: Mean voxel counts per sampled patch, then case equal; not native whole-case volumes
units.SD: Population SD across defined PROBE12 case Dice fractions; displayed×100pp
units.fine: Per case sum fine_covered / sum fine_nodes, then mean of supported cases; patch means separately retained
units.null: Undefined/unsupported remains null; CSV empty cell is null, never zero
units.tail: Own worst2 can contain different cases per arm; matched-worst2 holds reference case IDs fixed
units.dependence: Repeated/overlapping patches, same12 TRAIN cases and three seeds are not independent validation cohorts
